supported.meaning: The exact declared scope has a dispatchable implementation and complete public conformance evidence.
supported.claimRule: Capabilities also require metadata, executor, input/output schemas, conformance fixture, and QA assertions.

experimental.meaning: A bounded path or contract exists but stability, coverage, or required evidence is incomplete.
experimental.claimRule: Must be labeled experimental at every API, CLI, and documentation boundary.

manual.meaning: The result depends on an explicit trusted human or external-runtime gate.
manual.claimRule: Must remain unresolved until recorded manual evidence exists and can never become an automatic pass.

unsupported.meaning: The current product does not accept or promise the item.
unsupported.claimRule: Reject or report unavailable before output mutation; never silently flatten or infer a fallback.

inputs.label: Data-only capability overlay and semantic bindings
inputs.currentBasis: The public schema and resolver do not exist in this repository.
limitations: Planning text is not an accepted input contract.

inputs.label: Versioned deck and slide specification
inputs.currentBasis: No DeckSpec or SlideSpec schema or dispatcher exists.
limitations: No data can currently be validated or rendered.

inputs.label: Local JPEG asset
inputs.currentBasis: No asset policy, decoder boundary, or placement executor exists.
limitations: Local files are not searched or implicitly admitted.

inputs.label: LaTeX formula input
inputs.currentBasis: The optional Pandoc/OMML adapter is not implemented.
limitations: Pandoc is not bundled and predecessor observations are not public evidence.

inputs.label: Macro-enabled presentation or template
inputs.currentBasis: Macros are outside the 0.x trusted input boundary.
limitations: Executable rejection is not proven until secure ingestion exists.

inputs.label: PDF, office, design, HTML, or image document import
inputs.currentBasis: Semantic import from arbitrary document/design formats is a 0.x non-goal.
limitations: Individual local image assets are separate future inputs, not document import.

inputs.label: Local PNG asset
inputs.currentBasis: No asset policy, decoder boundary, or placement executor exists.
limitations: Local files are not searched or implicitly admitted.

inputs.label: User-owned POTX template
inputs.currentBasis: No secure archive ingestion or template inspector exists.
limitations: The repository gate intentionally rejects committed POTX binaries.

inputs.label: User-owned PPTX template
inputs.currentBasis: No secure archive ingestion or template inspector exists.
limitations: The repository gate intentionally rejects committed PPTX binaries.

inputs.label: Versioned project configuration
inputs.currentBasis: ProjectConfig and ProjectContext are architecture contracts only.

inputs.label: Local SVG asset
inputs.currentBasis: No SVG safety profile or placement executor exists.

inputs.label: Template profile and normalized index

inputs.label: Unknown or unlisted input

limitations: No extension, content, or compatibility inference is allowed.
inputs.roadmap: Requires an explicit future matrix and contract revision

ooxmlFeatures.label: ActiveX controls
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: ActiveX is high-risk and outside the 0.x input policy.
limitations: Rejection mutations are deferred to secure ingestion.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Animations and transitions
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Arbitrary animation behavior is a 0.x non-goal.
limitations: No preservation or mutation guarantee exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Native charts
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Native chart generation has not been specified.
limitations: No schema, executor, fixture, or QA assertions exist.
ooxmlFeatures.roadmap: Deferred beyond the initial vertical slice

ooxmlFeatures.label: Content types and internal relationships
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Relationship validation is a target contract only.
limitations: No secure parser or public mutation suite exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Package digital signatures
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Signature preservation and verification are unspecified.
limitations: No signed-package compatibility promise exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Native DrawingML text and shapes
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: A minimal native component is planned but not implemented.
limitations: No editability or rendering claim exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Embedded fonts
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Font redistribution and embedded-font handling are outside the current rights boundary.
limitations: User-installed font naming does not authorize font redistribution.
ooxmlFeatures.roadmap: Requires a separate rights and security decision

ooxmlFeatures.label: Embedded packages and files
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Embedded payloads are high-risk and outside the 0.x policy.
limitations: Rejection mutations are deferred to secure ingestion.

ooxmlFeatures.label: External OOXML relationships
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Network and external target resolution are outside the trusted boundary.
limitations: No relationship may trigger network access.

ooxmlFeatures.label: VBA and macro parts
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Executable macro content is outside the 0.x policy.
limitations: No macro preservation or execution claim exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Slide masters, layouts, and themes
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Template inspection and clone/fill behavior are not implemented.
limitations: No preservation or binding guarantee exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Audio and video media
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Media preservation, codecs, and external references are unspecified.
limitations: No package or playback compatibility promise exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Native OMML formula shape
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: The optional transplantation adapter is not implemented in this repository.
limitations: Predecessor automation evidence is inadmissible; native editability also needs a manual gate.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Speaker notes and comments
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Notes/comments preservation and private-content redaction are unspecified.
limitations: These parts may contain undisclosed private content.
ooxmlFeatures.roadmap: Requires an explicit feature and privacy contract

ooxmlFeatures.label: OLE objects
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: OLE payloads are high-risk and outside the 0.x policy.
limitations: Rejection mutations are deferred to secure ingestion.

ooxmlFeatures.label: OPC ZIP package container
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Secure ZIP/XML ingestion is not implemented.
limitations: No archive limit, traversal, duplicate, or bomb defense is executable yet.

ooxmlFeatures.label: PNG and JPEG image parts
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Image-part validation and placement are not implemented.
limitations: No metadata, size, decoder, or relationship policy exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Native slide text
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: No semantic binding or clone/fill executor exists.
limitations: No editability, overflow, or font claim exists.

ooxmlFeatures.label: SVG image parts
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: No SVG safety profile or DrawingML placement exists.
limitations: Scripts, links, fonts, and renderer variance remain unspecified.

ooxmlFeatures.label: Native tables
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Native table generation has not been specified.
limitations: No schema, executor, fixture, or QA assertions exist.
ooxmlFeatures.roadmap: Deferred beyond the initial vertical slice

ooxmlFeatures.label: Unknown or unlisted OOXML feature
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Unknown package features fail closed.
limitations: No preservation-by-default or image-flattening fallback is allowed.
ooxmlFeatures.roadmap: Requires explicit classification, contract, and conformance evidence

ooxmlFeatures.label: Unknown vendor extension XML
ooxmlFeatures.currentBasis: Unknown vendor XML is outside the 0.x preservation contract.
limitations: Silent round-trip preservation is not promised.
ooxmlFeatures.roadmap: Requires explicit feature classification and tests

evidenceLevels.label: Automated public synthetic conformance evidence
evidenceLevels.currentBasis: Foundation policy-gate tests exist, but no public PPTX fixture or product flow exists.
limitations: Cannot support a PPTX capability until its complete conformance artifacts exist.

evidenceLevels.label: Compilation or syntax success only
evidenceLevels.currentBasis: Compilation is explicitly insufficient release or support evidence.
limitations: Does not prove dispatch, mutation safety, output correctness, or compatibility.

evidenceLevels.label: Trusted manual or desktop-runtime evidence
evidenceLevels.currentBasis: The architecture and private-fixture policy define a manual evidence lane.
limitations: Cannot be promoted to an automated pass or required by public CI.

artifacts.note: Constrains trusted local evidence and redaction.

evidenceLevels.label: Predecessor implementation observation
evidenceLevels.currentBasis: Predecessor observations are design inputs, not evidence for this repository.
limitations: Cannot establish rights, implementation, conformance, or public support.
evidenceLevels.roadmap: Replace only with clean-room public evidence

evidenceLevels.label: Optional private compatibility probe
evidenceLevels.currentBasis: Private probes may identify narrow compatibility defects or evidence.
limitations: Never required for reproduction and never generalizes to arbitrary templates.
evidenceLevels.roadmap: Capability-specific compatibility testing after public conformance

evidenceLevels.label: Missing or unavailable evidence
evidenceLevels.currentBasis: Missing evidence remains visible and cannot be converted to pass.
limitations: No support claim may be made.
evidenceLevels.roadmap: Supply the evidence required by the exact item contract

evidenceLevels.label: Visual similarity or screenshot review only
evidenceLevels.currentBasis: Visual plausibility does not prove OOXML validity, editability, or collateral isolation.
limitations: May supplement but never replace structural and capability evidence.
